purpose: Canonical pose and registration source for every layered visual attribute

clips.motion: quiet breathing and weight shift; feet remain planted
complete readable locomotion cycle with opposing arms and legs
gun-ready aim, recoil, recovery; hands preserve weapon socket
impact recoil, peak reaction, return transition
upright to grounded collapse; no disappearing body

rules: Every exported row uses the same cell and origin.
The base rig contains no equipment, armor, hair, face, or weapon artwork.
Every decorative attribute is authored over the rig but exported alone.
An attribute may use behind-body and front-of-body planes when it crosses the silhouette.
No duplicated or globally shifted frames count as authored animation.
